description: Deletes (discards) an evidence group. Irreversible. The platform refuses it when the group is CLOSING or already discarded, when the group is OPEN and any of its evidences is COMPLETED, and when the group is CLOSED (sealed) and holds no evidence at all or any evidence other than capture-metadata records: in practice neither a sealed group with real evidence nor an empty sealed group can be deleted. When it succeeds, the group's evidences go with it. Requires: case_file_create → caseFileId and evidence_group_create → evidenceGroupId, passed as id. Returns no body.
name: evidence_group_delete
